Lina V.: spotted periodic token jitter on mag-13b-int4-symm during longprefill tests (mix of shard-join + compaction). small but reproducible at certain join offsets.
Owen K.: how reproducible? single seed?
Lina V.: deterministic seed, fails every time when prefill ~98304 and shard join occurs. difflog sample:
[2026-05-10T11:02:01Z] PREFILL done tokens=98304
[2026-05-10T11:02:01Z] SHARD-JOIN start src=2 dst=0
[2026-05-10T11:02:01Z] SHARD-JOIN end duration=2ms
[2026-05-10T11:02:01Z] GENERATE idx=98305 expected="." got=";"
Diego R.: only on int4-symm? tried int4-asym, int8, fp16?
Lina V.: asym/int8/fp16 clean. int4-symm repros. unpack-ref path matches fp16 so bug in compact pack/unpack for symmetric table or during remap at join.
Owen K.: could be scale table sign or lowbits packing order when merging shards. does remap preserve absolute position indices (rope offsets)?
Lina V.: found discrepancy: when join merges odd-length final chunk, we reused the existing rot_scale pointer without recomputing per-new-chunk offset. quick patch to recompute rot_scale on join pushed: lina/rot-join-rescale.
qa-bot: scheduled long-kv-fuzz on branch lina/rot-join-rescale (job id: 2026-05-10-9901). ETA 1h.
Diego R.: add a unit that synthesizes odd-length join boundary and asserts token equality against fp16 baseline.
Lina V.: added test + small csv writer for quant matrix runs (int4-symm,int4-asym,int8,fp16) with prefill sweep 16k/64k/98k/131k, recording token_diff and p95 latency.
ci-bot: PR lina/rot-join-rescale -> staging queued: smoke,long-kv-suite,unit-kv.
Owen K.: if patch fixes it, consider caching rescale params keyed by (chunk_len,quant_table) to avoid recompute overhead.
Lina V.: agreed, filing a follow-up perf task after correctness verified. will report results when fuzz completes.
